subject.title: fix: preserve selected GitHub skills across resync

question: Should new multi-skill GitHub sources permanently require explicit saved skill-path selection while existing sources without a selection continue syncing all detected skills?
rationale: This is a new persisted user-visible source mode with long-lived synchronization and upgrade semantics; a mechanical fix can align counts, but it cannot choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Adopt explicit selection for new sources
options.body: Keep legacy sources in all-skills mode, require selection for new multi-skill repositories, and align preview, real sync, and dry-run reporting.

options.title: Keep all-skills as the default
options.body: Remove the mandatory selection flow and preserve the historical behavior for all repositories, accepting bundled-skill discovery on later syncs.

recommendation.title: Adopt explicit selection for new sources
recommendation.body: Keep legacy sources in all-skills mode, require selection for new multi-skill repositories, and align preview, real sync, and dry-run reporting.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the available recent contributor for the proposed GitHub-source selection model.
